name: Disharmony of Flame
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The elders have felt a disturbance amongst the elements. The Dark Iron dwarves have summoned a foul spirit into our world that threatens to plague our lands with an eternal draught. This disharmony of flame must be investigated.

Travel to Blackrock Mountain, through the Chasm of Flame, into the quarry. It is there that you shall find this lord of fire: Overmaster Pyron.

End the disruption and return to me.
narrative.objectives: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.
narrative.offerRewardText: This cannot be... it must not be. The destruction of Pyron has merely lifted a veil. Within the depths of Blackrock is a much more insidious source of corruption.
narrative.requestItemsText: The elements are still in disarray, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 52 to 60, 48,300 XP in all.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.objectiveText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
quests.objectiveText: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdoms
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
